subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexaaquachromium(III)（[Cr(H₂O)₆]³⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square pyramidal
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Cr (group 6) 6 e; 6 × H₂O (L) 12 e; the 3+ charge removes 3 e: 15 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 3+ charge, so the metal is Cr(III), d³; d³ + 12 e from the ligands = 15 e.
